title: Beasts of Aethelgard – Domestication
content:
Domestication and use vary by region and creature.

The Solar Empire breeds warhorses with minor enchantments woven into their bloodlines. These steeds are unfazed by fire or the scent of blood and can maintain a gallop for hours beyond their natural endurance.

The Dwarven Hegemony trains tunnel haunts—large lizard-like creatures from the deep—as pack animals in passages too narrow for ponies and too dangerous to travel unsupervised.

The Federation of Ashlands has domesticated the ash-strider, a flightless bird tall enough to be ridden. Her legs are covered in heat-resistant scales, and her eggs provide protein in the soil where little grows.

Whale halflings maintain symbiotic relationships with several species of herd animals—neither fully domesticated nor entirely wild. These animals follow landships and provide milk, wool, and sometimes meat in exchange for protection from the most dangerous predators.
